description: This file contains utility functions for testing React components, including rendering wrappers with context providers and routers, as well as mock fetch functions for simulating API responses.

methods.name: renderWithAppProvider
methods.description: Renders a UI component wrapped only with the AppProvider context, without any Router.

methods.name: renderWithRouterOnly
methods.description: Renders a UI component wrapped only with a router (BrowserRouter or MemoryRouter), useful for components that depend on routing but are not the entire app.

methods.name: renderWithAppProviderAndRouter
methods.description: Renders a UI component wrapped with both AppProvider and Router, for components that need both context and routing.

methods.name: mockFetchOnce
methods.description: Mocks the global fetch function to return a specific data response once, with optional status and headers.

methods.name: mockFetchOnceError
methods.description: Mocks the global fetch function to throw an error response once, simulating a failed fetch request.
